title.th: คำสั่งตามมาตรา 11(3)

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275)
Order under Section 11 (3)
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 1st July 2005:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 31st July 2005, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
1. Accountants Act (Chapter 2)
2. Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority Act (Chapter 2A)
3. Business Trusts Act (Chapter 31A)
4. Estate Duty Act (Chapter 96)
5. Goods and Services Tax Act (Chapter 117A)
6. Human Cloning and Other Prohibited Practices Act (Chapter 131B)
7. Human Organ Transplant Act (Chapter 131A)
8. Manufacture of Optical Discs Act (Chapter 170C)
9. Patents Act (Chapter 221)
10. Registered Designs Act (Chapter 266)
11. Trade Marks Act (Chapter 332)
12. Trustees Act (Chapter 337)
